verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management platform, so letting an agent draft securities through a programmatic surface is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence shows no public API: every OpenAPI candidate path returns 404. The documented grant and issue flows (granting options, issuing shares, admin review of exercises) are all manual UI actions. The HRIS integration and llms.txt file do not show any programmatic way to draft grants or queue them for board approval.
